scope: 384 DEV only, 128 questions and distinct image groups per task
route: if observed PixelPrune t020 selected_count <= threshold choose same-question accepted t0 score and t0 selected_count; else choose t020 score and selected_count
output: per task and threshold: full denominator, fallback count/rate, mean chosen K, mean original K for each source, mean score, t0 and EADP K256 paired score differences and percentile 95% image-group bootstrap intervals, improved/declined/unchanged counts
limitations: policy defined after observing both DEV arms, exploratory and not confirmatory
routing is an offline counterfactual, not an actual conditional model execution or trained policy
score files contain prediction text; parsing source records necessarily opens them
fallback checks both selectors and the additional selection cost is not measured
routed mean K is output token budget only, not equal FLOPs or end-to-end runtime
no new CONFIRM/FINAL labels or results
